channel.title: Peninsula Insider
channel.description: Editorial coverage of the Mornington Peninsula - eat, stay, do, wine, and the weekend curated.

item.title: Dromana Hotel deck, wildflower heathland at Greens Bush, and the Dromana Community Market
item.description: The Dromana Hotel's bay-view deck in first-spring warmth, the spider orchids peaking along Greens Bush, and Saturday's Dromana Community Market before the crowds.

item.title: Main Ridge Dairy, Seawinds Gardens, and Pt. Leo's sculpture park
item.description: Build a spring day around Main Ridge Dairy's goat cheeses, the short paths at Seawinds Gardens, and sculpture at Pt. Leo Estate.

item.title: Jetty Road's spring seasonals, the Western Port wildflower heathlands, and NWOP at MPRG
item.description: Jetty Road Brewery's rotating spring taps in Dromana, the heathland wildflower bloom along the Coolart Wetlands boardwalk, and National Works on Paper 2026 at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery before November.

item.title: Spring school holidays on the Peninsula
item.description: One good activity at a time: creative workshops, outdoor days and holiday programmes for 19 September to 4 October 2026.

item.title: Portsea Hotel's beer garden, the Point Nepean orchid flush, and Red Hill Truffles' last hunts
item.description: The Portsea Hotel deck in first-spring warmth, the native orchids peaking along Point Nepean's Number 2 Rifle Range track, and the final truffle hunts of the season at Red Hill Truffles in Main Ridge.

item.description: Kerri Greens' single-vineyard Pinot at the Merricks cellar door, the Olivers Hill coastal bluff at peak wildflower, and VIRAL Food Festival at Mornington Racecourse from Friday.

item.title: A Practical Spring Visit to National Works on Paper
item.description: The confirmed dates, regular opening hours and location for a straightforward gallery visit in Mornington.

item.description: Barragunda Dining's spring farm menu at Cape Schanck, the clifftop wildflower walk from Bushrangers Bay to Cape Schanck, and the National Works on Paper 2026 exhibition at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery.

item.description: Two Bays' gluten-free pale ale on the Dromana deck, the Arthurs Seat wildflower circuit at peak wattle, and National Works on Paper 2026 at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery.

item.description: The Continental's rooftop at the first warm dusk of spring, the Greens Bush loop as yellow-faced honeyeaters return, and Balnarring Farmers' Market for the season's first new-season garlic.

item.description: Spider orchids along the Moorooduc Plains grassland loop and the final Red Hill truffle hunt window before season close.

item.description: The Sunday roast at St Andrews Beach Brewery, the Greens Bush woodland loop as wattlebirds return, and one of the last Red Hill truffle hunts of 2026.

item.description: Flinders Sourdough's almond croissants on a spring morning, the Bushrangers Bay cliff track in its first wattle-free bloom window, and the National Works on Paper show at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery through November.

item.description: Moke Dining's five-course Saturday lunch in Flinders, the Arthurs Seat wildflower corridor at its September peak, and the National Works on Paper show opening at Mornington Peninsula Regional Gallery.

item.title: The Last Weekend of Winter

item.title: Boat Moorings and Berths on the Mornington Peninsula
item.description: Annual mooring waiting lists, seasonal moorings you can actually book this season, and the one short-stay berth at Mornington Pier itself - the honest picture of where to put a boat on the Peninsula, and who to actually contact.

item.description: Sunday lunch at Ten Minutes by Tractor, the Arthurs Seat Eagle open for morning rides in clear winter light, and a closing-weekend chance to see ceramics from Tuck Studio at MPRG.

item.title: The Winter Long Lunch: Vineyard Dining Room or Coastal Pub
item.description: Two very different versions of the same afternoon. Here's how to pick the right one for the day you're actually having.

item.title: Insider Picks - 12 August 2026
item.description: Moke Dining's five-course winter set menu in Flinders, the gannet colony at Point Danger in peak winter season, and the Helen Britton retrospective closing at MPRG this Sunday.

item.title: Insider Picks: 10 August 2026
item.description: The Bay Hotel Mornington's vault dining room for a winter occasion, the Red Hill Brewery Secret Stash Weekend this Saturday and Sunday, and The Heritage at Balnarring for a pub lunch beside an open fire.

item.title: Stonier Fire & Wine Lunch and a Winter Whale Watch Window
item.description: Stonier Wines fires up a winter lunch in Merricks, and the whale migration corridor off Cape Schanck peaks in August.

item.title: Indoor Play on the Mornington Peninsula: The Four Worth Driving To
item.description: When the weather turns and the kids need to run, there are four indoor play venues on the Peninsula that actually hold up. Here is what each one is good for, and the five things to check before you leave the house.

item.title: Insider Picks: 6 August 2026

item.title: Insider Picks: 2 August 2026

item.description: St Andrews Beach Brewery's Sunday roast in the old stables, a winter low-tide walk at Bushrangers Bay, and Two Bays Brewing's gluten-free pale ale that non-coeliacs keep quietly ordering.

item.description: The Sorrento Hotel's parma on Ocean Beach Road, the winter-emptied Gunnamatta back-beach trail, and a community sleepout at The Ranch in Boneo this Friday night.

item.title: Insider Picks - 30 July 2026

item.title: Insider Picks: 25 July 2026

item.description: A fireside duck dish at Ten Minutes by Tractor, a winter dawn walk to Cape Schanck, and a photography show closing soon at Mornington's two-storey gallery.
